layout: Clean calendar/schedule page. Light bg. Top nav with title 'My Schedule'. Save button top-right.
elements: HEADER: 'Set Your Availability' in navy h2, subtitle 'Choose when you're available for sessions'
WEEKLY GRID: 7 days (Mon-Sun) in a vertical list
- Toggle switch on/off (green when on, gray when off)
- When ON: time range picker — two dropdowns or sliders for Start Time and End Time (30-min increments: 06:00, 06:30, 07:00...)
- Optional: '+' button to add multiple time blocks per day (e.g. Monday 07:00-10:00 AND 16:00-19:00)
'Apply to all weeks' checkbox below the grid
UPCOMING BOOKINGS section: List of already-booked sessions (read-only, cannot edit time of booked slots)
notes: Simple and functional. Toggle switch is large and easy to tap. Time picker uses dropdowns (clearer than dragging for 40+ users).
